technique.jjksample.ember_lance.desc: A fast, piercing lance of burning cursed energy.

vow.jjksample.still_feet.desc: Never sprint. Riverstep reaches further under it.

culling_rule.jjksample.first_blood.name: First Blood
item.jjksample.bonewood_staff.desc: Retuned by the sample pack: lends Ember Lance at a tenth off.
